question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Judicious
solution: The correct answer is '**Foolish**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate antonym of the given word '**Judicious**' is '**Foolish**'. • **Judicious**: (used about a decision or an action) sensible and carefully considered; showing good judgment. [(निर्णय या कार्रवाई) बुद्धिमत्तापूर्ण और सुविचारित; विवेकपूर्ण विवेक-सम्‍मत] • *Example: We should listen to the **judicious** opinion of that old man.* • **Foolish**: silly; not sensible. (बेवक़ूफ़; बेअक़ल, बुद्धिहीन, विवेकहीन) • *Example: I was **foolish** enough to trust him.* **Correct Answer:__** *Foolish.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Modest**: not talking too much about your own abilities, good qualities, etc. [विनम्र, विनीत (अपनी क्षमताओं आदि का बखान न करने वाला)] • **Reserved**: shy and keeping your feelings hidden. (संकोची तथा मनोभावों को छिपाकर रखने वाला) • **Authoritative**: having authority; demanding or expecting that people obey you. (अधिकारिक; आदेशात्‍मक, आज्ञासूचक) 3e:T588, The correct answer is** 'Everyone has good luck or success at a point of time'.**
